Judging each item against its cited page:

- **CT items (0, 1, 2, 14, 15, 17, 20, 21):** CT is $275 per scan in the outpatient hospital section (page 50) and in the general diagnostic section (page 49). The unit "per visit" does not match "per scan", so I rejected items 2, 15, 17 and 21. Items 0, 1, 14 and 20 use "per scan" or "per CT scan", so they pass.
- **Diagnostic radiology other than CT (3, 4, 11, 12, 13, 18):** The $275 copay applies to diagnostic radiology other than CT. The benefit `imaging.diagnostic` is acceptable for this row. "Per visit" is the wrong unit, so items 3 and 13 fail. Items 4, 11, 12 and 18 use "per service" units, so they pass.
- **MRI, PET, nuclear and ultrasound (5, 16, 19, 22, 23):** The quote covers all non-CT diagnostic radiology, not MRI, PET, nuclear or ultrasound specifically. Labeling the row as one of these is a mismatch, so I rejected all of them.
- **X-ray (6, 7, 10, 24):** X-ray is $10 per x-ray. Items 7 and 24 use "per x-ray" and pass. Items 6 and 10 use "per visit" and fail. Item 7 has setting `any` on page 49, which is the general section, so it passes. Item 24 is the outpatient hospital setting on page 51, which also fits.
- **Diagnostic mammogram (8, 9, 25):** The $0 copay per diagnostic mammogram on page 32 appears in the breast cancer screening row. Item 9 says "per diagnostic mammogram" and passes. Item 25 says "per mammogram", which is close but could be read as covering screening mammograms, so I rejected it. Item 8 uses "per visit", which fails.
